meta.name: Arcade
meta.shortDescription: Retro Dogecoin arcade with pay-to-play timer
meta.longDescription:
Retro launcher at `/` lists games discovered from `static/games/*/game.json`. Each game can use its own payout address via env `PAYOUT_GAME_<ID>` with hyphens converted to underscores (example: `PAYOUT_GAME_FEAR_THE_DOGE`). If unset, `PAYOUT_DOGE_ADDRESS` is used as fallback for that game.

**GigaWallet (optional):** set `ARCADE_GIGAWALLET_ADMIN_URL` (e.g. `http://gigawallet:8081`), `ARCADE_GIGAWALLET_INVOICE_GAMES` (comma list, e.g. `doge-mine-quest`), and per-game `ARCADE_GIGAWALLET_ACCOUNT_<GAME_ID_UNDERSCORED>` as the [GigaWallet foreign ID](https://gigawallet.dogecoin.org/docs/accounts) (must match an account you created in GigaWallet). The game client calls `POST /api/gigawallet/play-invoice` to mint an invoice (HD deposit address). **Payment detection stays on MemeTracker or arcade P2P mempool** — new invoice addresses are registered for watching; GigaWallet chain sync is not used for playtime. **Reward payouts:** set `ARCADE_ENABLE_PAYOUTS` and `ARCADE_PAYOUT_BACKEND=gigawallet`; the same foreign ID is used for `POST /account/:foreignID/pay` (no WIF on the arcade pup).

Payments: **P2P mode (default)** — mempool detection over Dogecoin peers (BIP144 inv/getdata), watching each deposit address. **MemeTracker mode** — set `USE_MEMETRACKER` to true and `MEMETRACKER_BASE_URL` (e.g. `http://memetracker:8080`); the service polls `GET {base}/track/{address}` for each watched address (including every GigaWallet invoice address).

Play time counts down only while a game page is open (state poll touch + grace window). Logs: `ARCADE_P2P_LOG`. TOP 10 leaderboard remains SQLite on the pup volume.

After configuration changes, disable and re-enable this pup to apply settings.
